capability_semantics: A non-zero pinned Text v2 dissolve requires cutly.transition-scope.text-pinned-font-viewport-px.v1, cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 and cutly.transition.dissolve.v1 plus every authored property/keyframe capability. A zero-width hard cut requires no transition or scoped-transition capability.
excluded_responsibilities: This amendment does not make a visible-only static Text provider transition-capable. Rich text, fallback fonts, mixed-script inference, non-dissolve transitions, masks, provider/runtime attestation, encoding and publication remain outside this scope.
failure_semantics: Unsupported Text profiles, non-adjacent or cross-track clips, disabled clips, wrong transition role/scope/time/paint, absent scoped capability, missing font authorization or any receipt mismatch fail closed without a partial surface.
handle_semantics: The active half-open window and complementary weights remain exactly cutly.evaluator.transition-dissolve.v1. Text source bytes need no temporal media handles, but a transition-capable renderer must authorize the exact transition ID, role and evaluator handle time; visible-time clamping is forbidden.
provider_semantics: A transition-aware Text provider binds the complete document/timeline/track/transition/clip/asset/font scope, outgoing or incoming role, actual evaluator timeline/local/source time, evaluated paint, intrinsic viewport and complete authenticated shaping/raster receipt chain. An ordinary visible-only static Text provider does not satisfy this scope.
scope_semantics: The existing dissolve profile may connect adjacent enabled clips on one TrackKindText only when both clips reference AssetKindText sources using cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2. Legacy Text v1, mixed tracks and mixed source kinds remain invalid.
source_semantics: Each Text source is an immutable intrinsic raster expression for its frozen shaping and layout identity. The evaluator still resolves every authored clip property and text.fill keyframe at each exact outgoing or incoming handle time.
